info.title: API.SH: Geo Data
info.description: The Geo Data API from API.SH: public Geo Data data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

200.description: The stored response (headers: x-refetch: 1, x-original-time, x-original-route).

get.description:
Towns and cities (1,000+ people) whose name in any language starts with the query, exact names first, then by population: GeoNames id, name, ASCII name, the alternate name that matched, coordinates, country, region (admin1) and county (admin2), population, elevation, time zone and place type (capital, administrative seat, populated place...). Filter by country, region, type, GeoNames feature code and population range, and sort by relevance, population or name. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page. Data: GeoNames (CC BY 4.0).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/geo-cities

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Name or its beginning (3+ characters for prefix search), any language: `paris`, `münchen`, `東京`.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: ISO country code or English name.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Region (admin1) code or name, e.g. `IL` or `Illinois`. Also accepted as `admin1`.

parameters.name: min_population
parameters.description: Only places with at least this many people.

parameters.name: max_population
parameters.description: Only places with at most this many people.

parameters.name: feature_code
parameters.description: GeoNames place codes, comma-separated, e.g. `PPLC` (capital), `PPLA` (region seat), `PPLA2`, `PPL` (populated place), `PPLX` (section of a city).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order: `relevance` (default: exact names first, then by population), `population` (largest first) or `name` (A-Z).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One place by GeoNames id: name, coordinates, country, region, county, population, elevation, time zone with its current local time and UTC offset, and place type. Data: GeoNames (CC BY 4.0).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/geo-city

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every country and territory: ISO-2/ISO-3/numeric and FIPS codes, name, capital, continent, area, population, internet domain, currency code and name, calling code, postal code format and pattern, languages, GeoNames id, neighbouring countries and flag emoji. Filter by continent, currency, language or name. Data: GeoNames (CC BY 4.0).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/geo-countries

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Country or capital name contains this text.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One country by ISO-2, ISO-3 code or English name: codes, name, capital (with its coordinates, time zone and population), continent, area, population, internet domain, currency, calling code, postal code format and pattern and how many postal codes we hold, languages, neighbours (with names) and flag emoji. Data: GeoNames (CC BY 4.0).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/geo-country

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Great-circle distance in km, miles and nautical miles, and the initial compass bearing, between two places (names) or points (`lat,lon`), with both places resolved.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/geo-distance

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Ground elevation above mean sea level (metres and feet) at one point or up to 50 points, from open terrain models (SRTM, GMTED2010, ETOPO1, NED and others) on a grid of about 10 m, with the grid resolution at each point.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/geo-elevation

parameters.name: points
parameters.description: Several points instead: lat,lon pairs separated by |, up to 50, e.g. `46.5197,7.4815|36.0544,-112.1401`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Towns and cities (1,000+ people) within a radius of a point, nearest first, with distance: GeoNames id, name, coordinates, country, region, county, population, elevation, time zone and type. Use `min_population` to find the nearest large city. Data: GeoNames (CC BY 4.0).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/geo-nearby

parameters.name: min_population
parameters.description: Only places with at least this many people.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Places for a postal code in ~120 countries (full codes for the UK, Canada and the Netherlands): place name, region and code, county and code, district, coordinates and accuracy. A longer code than the data holds (ZIP+4, a full code where only outward codes exist) returns its parent (`match: parent`); a partial code returns codes starting with it (`match: prefix`). Data: GeoNames (CC BY 4.0).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/geo-postal-code

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Postal code, any spacing or case: `90210`, `SW1A 1AA`, `75008`.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: ISO country code or English name (default US). See /geo/v1/postal-code-countries.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The countries /geo/v1/postal-code covers, with the number of codes each has.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/geo-postal-code-countries

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: States and regions of a country
get.description:
The first-level divisions of a country (states, provinces, regions, counties...) with their codes, names and GeoNames ids.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/geo-states

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: ISO code or English country name.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only regions whose name contains this text.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Time zone of a point or place: IANA name, abbreviation, current local time, UTC offset, standard and daylight-saving offsets, whether DST is observed and in effect now, and the nearest place. Data: GeoNames (CC BY 4.0).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/geo-timezone

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude (-90 to 90). Pass with `lon`; or use `q`, `postal_code` or `geonameid` instead.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Place name in any language, optionally with region and country: `Paris`, `Springfield, IL, US`, `München`. The most populous match wins (towns of 1,000+ people).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country for `q` or `postal_code`: ISO code (`US`, `GB`, `DE`) or English name.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
